name: ModelVariant653_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant653_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (an emitter swings out from the slot and back dropping textured shells, then releases a ring of cones that each launch a wire sphere of lines); for a non-negative request it reads the 0xC-byte command row indexed by the request for the start delay, radius, height and shell and line colours, seeds the emitters, shells, cones and spheres and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 1 when the first cone launches its sphere, 2 once every element is inactive (restoring the slot shadow) and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the PAL header-670 and 737 images build it from the same source without the work-size printf and its string and bind its data names 0x28 lower; the Japanese images keep a wrapper only for the format-string padding byte. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
